decision_clock: Observed signal-session close T; next NYSE session is the due date
submission_budget: Observed cash plus estimated T-close sale proceeds net of the same fixed fees; SELL first, alphabetical ticker order within each side
buy_submission: At T cap requested shares to the remaining T budget including fees; freeze shares and side in immutable order records
audit: Intent preserves target weights, reference equity/cash, immutable orders and per-ticker requested signed delta / submitted signed delta / reference close, including zero submissions
fill: At next exact NYSE daily close use submitted shares and side; future price is execution outcome and NAV only
gap_cash_policy: Reject an unaffordable BUY in full; zero fill, zero rejection fee, no resizing, redistribution, replacement, retry or reversal
proceeds_assumption: Earlier simulated SELL net proceeds fund later BUY affordability; this sequencing and full-fill assumption are research conventions, not verified exchange or broker support
fatal_policy: Missing or duplicate exact price, invalid basis/state or any native quantity change rolls back the entire advance including pending orders and outcomes
cash_carry: Existing C0 none; environment overrides remain disabled
